title: Knool Khol: modeled ₹366/qtl left, Kathua → Rajouri (F&V)
summary: May 2022: reported knool Khol prices at Kathua and Rajouri (F&V) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 77% of 13 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹366 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 2 same-variety market pairs screened for knool Khol in May 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Rajouri (F&V) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: May 2022
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Rajouri (F&V) (Jammu and Kashmir) both reported knool Khol prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 13 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹1,500 per quintal. Rajouri (F&V) reported a median ₹1,900 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹400 per quintal, and Rajouri (F&V) was dearer on 85% of days.

scenes.headline: 230 km by road
scenes.caption: 230 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹50/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹136 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹13 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Rajouri (F&V) report, the rule selects 11 of 13 modeled shipping days. 10 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹366 per quintal (₹250 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Knool Khol route from Kathua to Rajouri (F&V) was positive on 77% of matched days in May 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,600, or ₹25,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to knool Khol
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹50/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Knool Khol route from Kathua to Rajouri (F&V) was positive on 77% of matched days in May 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,600, or ₹25,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
